source.what: Each proposal below was built by Trezu itself, not by Headcount: buildTemplateProposal from nt-fe/features/proposal-templates/build-proposal.ts, run on the manifests in templates/ and the form values given. Each manifest's verdict is Trezu's own parseManifest (nt-fe/features/proposal-templates/manifest.ts, zod 4.4.3 as Trezu's bun.lock pins it).
source.run: 2026-11-07 UTC, Node v26.13.0, outside this repository; only import specifiers were changed
source.license_note: Trezu publishes no license, so none of its code is in this repository: only these outputs, computed from our own manifests and values.
source.manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of the manifest's JSON with no whitespace (JSON.stringify of the parsed file), so an edited manifest no longer matches its recorded verdict and vectors
source.sandbox_vectors: Vectors whose 'what' starts with 'sandbox:' are the ones ts/sandbox/templates.test.ts files on the real Sputnik DAO; their accounts and round id are the sandbox's
